## What it is

The mounting ring. Four M3 holes on the 76.2 mm square, Ø3.4, and nothing else. Inside radius 49.18 mm, outside 58.58 mm, 2.4 mm thick. The cable comes up through the open middle.

## Design notes

- A tab stands up on each side of every tower. 2 mm thick, 4 mm tall, 2.4 mm along the radius, 0.1 mm off the bar.
- The inner edge of the ring is the part that sits in the tower slot. The screws are outside the bars.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't fill the middle of the ring. The cable comes up there.
- Don't move the four M3 holes. Those are the deck.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: thinned to the bolt circle. Tabs flank the towers. The middle is open for the cable.
